about: Table setups for the player lab (node lab/playerlab.js --env <name>, or every one at once with lab/testbench.js). seats = how many seats get players (spread around the table); mix = who sits down, in turn (repeat a type to see more of it); settings = the game's own settings menu (diff easy|normal|hard, density few|normal|lots, speed slow|normal|fast, boss 1|0, fire 1.5|3|6). Leave a field out to keep the default: 10 seats, all 8 types, normal settings.

full_house.about: Every seat taken, all 8 player types in rotation. The setup every run before 2026-10-18 used.

quiet_afternoon.about: Three regulars playing small: casuals, newbies and a grinder.

high_rollers.about: Six seats of big bettors chasing bosses and Sharks.

fishing_club.about: Mostly pole players, a couple of gunners.

beginners_night.about: Full table of new and casual players.

pros.about: Sharp players only: snipers, grinders and sprayers.

busy_fast_table.about: Full house on a table set to lots of fish, fast fish and 3 shots a second.
